selftest.title: Device test
selftest.note: Checks device, plugins, services and keys on this device. The report contains no keys and no location.
selftest.sentence: This is a test of the speech output.

data.title: Read data
data.note: Reads everything the OBD adapter and the ESP32 modules deliver and shows it as JSON to copy. It only reads; nothing is changed or sent. Without chassis number, keys and location; ESP32 data may contain the title of the music playing.
data.not_connected: No OBD adapter connected. Connect it first and switch on the ignition.
data.failed: The data could not be read.
